The plate is square and spans about 340 px in the image, which I take as roughly 24 cm, so about 14 px per cm.

**Pizza slice:** It measures roughly 85 px by 170 px, or about 6 cm by 12 cm. That is about 72 cm² at roughly 1.2 cm thick, or about 85 cm³. Pizza is fairly dense at around 0.8 g/cm³ once the air in the crust is accounted for, which gives about 70 g. A rectangular slice of this size (focaccia-style cheese pizza) is probably closer to 80 g, so I'll use 80 g. Cheese pizza is about 270 kcal/100 g.

**Cookie:** It is about 100 px across, or 7 cm. It is a chocolate cookie with white chocolate chips, about 1.2 cm thick. That gives a volume of about 46 cm³, but cookies are dense and a cookie this size usually weighs around 45 g. I'll use 45 g at about 450 kcal/100 g.
